caption: The drawing depicts a detailed, full-length dress in shades of lavender and cream, primarily viewed from the front. The bodice is closely fitted with a deep V neckline trimmed with light ruffles and lace, accented by lavender and silver lines, and features lace-trimmed elbow-length sleeves. The skirt is long and flowing, decorated with a floral pattern in pale yellow and white, and has two large bows at the front near the hemline. There are vertical panels of solid lavender fabric bordered with ruffles running down from the waist to the hem, splitting the floral-patterned central panel. The cuffs and neckline are adorned with lace or tulle ruffles in a light brown or beige color. To the upper right of the main dress, there is a smaller, lightly sketched outline of the dress from the back, showing a train that extends behind the skirt and additional detail lines without color. The background is plain, aged beige paper with no additional objects or decorations.
title: Dress
